includes: 6 Nights Accommodation with International Breakfast on sharing basis (Local 4 Star Hotel)
Bullet Train Second Class Seat (Kunming-Dali, Shangri La-Kunming)
Halal Meals as specified in itinerary
Entrance Fees as specified in itinerary
Boat tour at Dali Erhai Lake
Cable Car at Jade Dragon Snow Mountain
Buggy service at Dali Santorini & Shilin Stone Forest
excludes: Private Driver & Guide is base on 10 hours basis. Additional fees will be charged for every extra hour usage
Luggage, In Flight Meal & Airport Tax

itinerary.title: Kuala Lumpur - Kunming
activities: (Suggested Flight: AirAsia or Batik Air)
Arrive in Kunming Changshui Intl’ Airport
Airport Pickup
Transfer to hotel in Kunming and check in
Rest for the day

itinerary.title: Kunming - Dali [Bullet Train]
activities: After Breakfast, check out Hotel
Transfer to Dali by Bullet Train (~2 Hour)
Dali Foreigner Street & Dali Ancient Town
Dali Santorini (Include Return Buggy)
Dinner and check in Hotel in Dali

itinerary.title: Dali - Lijiang
activities: After breakfast, check out Hotel
Visit Dali Erhai Lake (Include Boat Tour)
Transfer to Lijiang by private transport (~3Hour Drive)
Lijiang Ancient City Tour (One of UNESCO best-preserved ancient towns in China)
Dinner and check-in Hotel in Lijiang

itinerary.title: Lijiang Tour
activities: Jade Dragon Snow Mountain (Enjoy scenic cable car ride up Glacier park at 4506M from sea level, higher than Mt. Kinabalu!)
Lijiang Impression Show
Blue Moon Valley & White Water River (Incl Battery Car)
Dongbaqu (A Cultural park of Naxi Heritage)
Dry Sea (Vast grassland at the foot of Jade Dragon Snow Mountain)
Lijiang Mosque
Dinner and back to Hotel in Lijiang

itinerary.title: Lijiang - Shangri La
activities: After breakfast, check out from hotel
Black Dragon Pool (Scenic Lake with Snow Mountain Backdrop)
Transfer to Shangri La by private transport (~2 Hour Drive)
Tiger Leaping Gorge (Breathtaking canyon on the Jinsha River + include escalator)
Dukezong Ancient Town
After dinner, check in to hotel at Shangri La

itinerary.title: Shangri La - Kunming [Bullet Train]
activities: After breakfast, check out from hotel
Transfer to Kunming by bullet train (~5-6 Hours)
Nanping Pedestrian Street (Souvenir shopping)
Visit Shuncheng Mosque (A historic mosque in Kunming that blends both Chinese & Islamic architecture)
After dinner, check in to hotel at Kunming

itinerary.title: Kunming City Tour + Airport Transfer
activities: After breakfast, check out from hotel
Transfer to Shilin Stone Forest (UNESCO Rated stunning limestone formations resembling a stone forest)
Kunming Waterfall Park
Visit Yongning Mosque
After dinner, transfer to airport for midnight flight

sub: Guests with an evening flight will transfer to the airport after lunch & the trip ends on Day 7.
Return flights from Kunming to KUL depart either in the evening (~5:00 PM, Day 7) or early morning (~2:00 AM, Day 8). Kindly book the correct timing or consult with our travel consultant.

expect.title: High Altitude Areas
expect.body: High altitude areas like Jade Dragon Snow Mountain may impose altitude sickness.

expect.title: Distant Drop Off & Pickup Point
expect.body: The drop-off point may not be directly at the entrance.

expect.title: Large Crowds
expect.body: Expect large crowds and queues in China, especially during holidays and peak travel seasons.

expect.title: Multiple Hotels
expect.body: Guests will stay in multiple hotels as the trip covers several cities across Yunnan.

expect.title: Intercity Transfer
expect.body: Intercity transfers via bullet trains and private transport.

expect.title: Communication & Payment
expect.body: Download WeChat and set up E-wallet as some places may prefer cashless payments.

Private transportation & tour guide is based on 10 hours basis. Additional fees will be charged for every extra hour usage. Payment must be paid in cash.
Quotation, itinerary and price are subject to change accordingly.
Final itinerary and hotel arrangements will be confirmed at least 15 days before the trip.
Please check with our staff on the trip validity before booking any connecting domestic flights.

deposit.text: prior to arrival for full payment
